context: A married couple reviews household finances at the table
purpose: Teach: 支給/引き上げ/就業/収支/不十分/金銭/増し/マネージャー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、今月の収支を一緒に見てくれる？正直、貯金が不十分で不安なのよ。
lines.en: Hey, can you look at this month's income and expenses with me? Honestly, our savings are insufficient and I'm worried.
lines.style: Concerned wife opening a serious financial discussion calmly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、見せて。先月ボーナスの支給があったのに、もう厳しいのか？
lines.en: Yeah, show me. We had the bonus payout last month, and it's already tight?
lines.style: Surprised husband leaning in to review the numbers.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 電気代が上がって、食費もいつの間にか増してて。私の金銭感覚がおかしいのかな。
lines.en: The electricity bill went up, and food costs have swelled before I noticed. Maybe my money sense is off.
lines.style: Self-doubting wife listing expense categories one by one.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 君のせいじゃないよ。会社の方も昇給の話がずっと止まってて、果たして動くのかも怪しい。
lines.en: It's not your fault. Talks about raises at work have stalled, and I doubt anything actually moves.
lines.style: Reassuring husband shifting blame onto company stagnation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あなた、就業後も残業ばかりで、昼間からあんなに疲れた顔して、無理してない？
lines.en: Even after your shift ends you're always doing overtime, and you look exhausted even in the daytime. Aren't you overdoing it?
lines.style: Wife expressing worry about her husband's health and hours.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 実は店舗マネージャーの話があってさ。会議の最中にチラッと聞いただけだけど、手当が付くらしいんだ。
lines.en: Actually there's talk of me becoming store manager. I caught wind during a meeting, and apparently there's an allowance.
lines.style: Husband sharing a hopeful career rumor cautiously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それ本当なら大きいじゃない。あっという間に夏になっちゃうし、まともに上司に確認してみたら？
lines.en: If that's real, it's huge. Summer will be here in no time — why not properly check with your boss?
lines.style: Wife pushing him to act on his career plans practically.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: わかった、来週ちゃんと話してみるよ。給料が引き上げられれば、君も少しは楽になるだろうし。
lines.en: Got it, I'll talk to him properly next week. If my pay gets bumped up, things should ease up for you a bit too.
lines.style: Husband closing with warm resolve to act on the rumor.
